scenes.title: The Non-Directional Edge: Trading Time and Volatility
scenes.purpose: Traditional investing requires predicting price direction; options allow trading volatility and time alone
takeaways: Traditional investing requires predicting price direction; options allow trading volatility and time alone
Traders can profit from the magnitude of a price move without knowing its direction
Part 2 masters Calendar Spreads, Straddles, Strangles, Strips, Straps, and the Earnings IV Crush

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Traditional investors always ask: Will the stock rise or fall? But in quantitative options, we generate edge without predicting direction.

hi.display: Traditional financial markets mein jab koi investor enter karta hai, toh uska pehla sawal hota hai: Kya stock upar jayega ya neeche? Lekin Quantitative Options Trading mein hum direction predict kiye bina bhi mathematical edge generate kar sakte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Non-Directional Edge: Trading Time and Volatility

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: You can trade two fundamental forces: Time (the passage of time) and Volatility (the expansion or collapse of market uncertainty).

hi.display: Aap sirf do fundamental forces par trade kar sakte hain: Time yaani samay ka beetna, aur Volatility yaani market ki halchal ka expand ya crush hona.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Non-Directional Edge: Trading Time and Volatility

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: John C. Hull demonstrates in Sections 12.4 and 12.5 how multi-leg options engineer market-neutral profitability.

hi.display: John C. Hull Section twelve point four aur twelve point five mein demonstrate karte hain ki multi-leg option combinations se market neutral profit kaise engineer kiya jata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Non-Directional Edge: Trading Time and Volatility

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: In this masterclass we master Calendar Spreads, Straddles, Strips, Straps, Strangles, and post-earnings Implied Volatility Crush.

hi.display: Is masterclass mein hum Calendar Spreads, Long aur Short Straddles, Strips, Straps, Strangles, aur corporate earnings ke around aane wale Implied Volatility Crush ko master karenge.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Non-Directional Edge: Trading Time and Volatility

scenes.title: Directional Speculation vs Pure Volatility Trading
scenes.purpose: Directional bets require being right on both direction and timing
takeaways: Directional bets require being right on both direction and timing
Volatility bets profit purely on whether realized volatility exceeds implied volatility priced into premiums
Delta neutrality insulates the portfolio against small underlying price oscillations

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Directional trading bets on market vectors. If you buy a call and the stock crashes, the entire premium is wiped out.

hi.display: Directional trading mein aap market ke vector par bet karte hain. Agar aapne call buy ki aur stock crash ho gaya, toh poora premium instantly zero ho jata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Directional Speculation vs Pure Volatility Trading

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Yet on binary events like elections or drug trials, huge moves are certain, but the direction remains completely unknown.

hi.display: Lekin binary events jaise election results ya drug trial announcements mein move toh huge aane wala hota hai, lekin kis direction mein aayega ye kisi ko nahi pata hota.

beats.onScreenIntent: Directional Speculation vs Pure Volatility Trading

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Pure volatility trading solves this dilemma: We ignore price drift and trade solely on movement magnitude or stillness.

hi.display: Pure volatility trading isi dilemma ko solve karti hai: Yahan hum stock ke drift ko ignore karke sirf price movement ki magnitude ya stillness par trade karte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Directional Speculation vs Pure Volatility Trading

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Let us first investigate the mechanics of the ultimate time-decay instrument: The Calendar Spread.

hi.display: Aaiye sabse pehle time decay ke master tool: Calendar Spread ke mechanics ko investigate karte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Directional Speculation vs Pure Volatility Trading

scenes.title: The Calendar Spread Engine: Exploiting Theta Acceleration
scenes.purpose: Option time decay accelerates non-linearly in the final 30 to 45 days before expiration
takeaways: Option time decay accelerates non-linearly in the final 30 to 45 days before expiration
A Calendar Spread sells a near-term option and buys a longer-dated option of the same strike
The short near-term option decays much faster than the long option, generating net positive Theta profit

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: A Calendar (Time) Spread combines two options with identical strike prices K, but different expiration dates.

hi.display: Calendar Spread yaani Time Spread do aise options ko combine karta hai jinka strike price K identical hota hai, lekin expiration dates different hoti hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Calendar Spread Engine: Exploiting Theta Acceleration

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: The trader writes a short-dated option T1 and buys a long-dated option T2. The core engine is non-linear Theta decay.

hi.display: Trader ek short-dated option T one sell karta hai aur ek long-dated option T two buy karta hai. Is trade ka core engine hai: Non-Linear Theta Decay.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Calendar Spread Engine: Exploiting Theta Acceleration

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: During the final 30 days of an option's life, time value evaporates exponentially, while far-dated options decay slowly.

hi.display: Options ki life ke aakhri 30 dinon mein time value exponentially fast evaporate hoti hai, jabki door ki expiry wale option par decay bohot slow hota hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Calendar Spread Engine: Exploiting Theta Acceleration

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: The short option melts rapidly toward zero while the long option retains value, harvesting the decay differential.

hi.display: Short option tezi se zero ki taraf melt hota hai jabki long option apni value preserve karta hai, aur is decay differential se net profit generate hota hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Calendar Spread Engine: Exploiting Theta Acceleration

scenes.title: Neutral, Bullish & Bearish Calendar Spreads
scenes.purpose: Neutral Calendar: Strike K set at-the-money (S0 = K); max profit achieved if stock closes exactly at K
takeaways: Neutral Calendar: Strike K set at-the-money (S0 = K); max profit achieved if stock closes exactly at K
Bullish Calendar: Strike K set out-of-the-money above spot; profits if stock rises moderately to strike K
Bearish Calendar: Strike K set out-of-the-money below spot using puts; profits if stock drifts down to strike K

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Calendar spreads are structured into three distinct variations based on market expectations.

hi.display: Calendar Spreads ko market expectation ke according teen distinct variations mein structure kiya jata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Neutral, Bullish & Bearish Calendar Spreads

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: First is the Neutral Calendar: Strike K is set at spot S0. Maximum profit is achieved if the stock remains flat until T1.

hi.display: Pehla hai Neutral Calendar Spread: Jahan strike K ko current spot S zero par set kiya jata hai. Agar stock short expiry tak flat rahe, toh maximum profit generate hota hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Neutral, Bullish & Bearish Calendar Spreads

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Second is Bullish Calendar with K above spot; third is Bearish Calendar with K below spot.

hi.display: Doosra hai Bullish Calendar jahan strike K spot se upar place kiya jata hai; aur teesra hai Bearish Calendar jahan strike K spot se neeche place kiya jata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Neutral, Bullish & Bearish Calendar Spreads

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: In both cases, the trader targets stock migration toward the specific strike price K by expiration T1.

hi.display: Dono cases mein trader expect karta hai ki stock expiration date T one tak targeted strike price K ke paas migrate karega.

beats.onScreenIntent: Neutral, Bullish & Bearish Calendar Spreads

scenes.title: The Long Straddle: Monetizing Explosive Market Disruption
scenes.purpose: A Long Straddle pairs 1 Call + 1 Put with identical strike K and expiration date T
takeaways: A Long Straddle pairs 1 Call + 1 Put with identical strike K and expiration date T
In Hull's example: S0 = $69, K = $70, c = $4.00, p = $3.00; Total Cost = $7.00 per share
Maximum loss is capped at $7.00; Breakevens are $63.00 ($70 - $7) and $77.00 ($70 + $7)

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Now we examine quantitative finance's most famous volatility strategy: The Long Straddle.

hi.display: Ab aate hain quantitative finance ki sabse famous volatility strategy par: The Long Straddle yaani Bottom Straddle.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Long Straddle: Monetizing Explosive Market Disruption

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: When a massive binary event looms—like clinical trials or regulatory rulings—and an explosive move is guaranteed but direction is unknown.

hi.display: Jab kisi company ke around koi massive binary event hone wala ho—jaise clinical trial verdict ya regulatory shock—aur aapko pata ho ki explosive move aayega lekin direction unknown ho.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Long Straddle: Monetizing Explosive Market Disruption

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: In a straddle, one call and one put are purchased at the identical strike K and maturity. The payoff forms a sharp V-shaped curve.

hi.display: Straddle mein ek Call aur ek Put dono same strike K aur same expiry par buy kiye jaate hain. Payoff ek sharp V-shape curve banata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Long Straddle: Monetizing Explosive Market Disruption

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Upper breakeven is K + (c+p) and lower is K - (c+p). An explosive breakout in either direction unlocks unlimited upside!

hi.display: Upper breakeven K plus total premium hota hai, aur lower breakeven K minus total premium hota hai. Stock kisi bhi taraf explode kare, unlimited profit unlock hota hai!

beats.onScreenIntent: The Long Straddle: Monetizing Explosive Market Disruption

scenes.title: The Short Straddle: High-Stakes Volatility Selling
scenes.purpose: A Short Straddle sells 1 Call + 1 Put at the same strike K, collecting upfront premium c + p
takeaways: A Short Straddle sells 1 Call + 1 Put at the same strike K, collecting upfront premium c + p
Maximum profit is capped at the premium collected ($7.00), realized if stock finishes at K
Faces unlimited loss liability on upside rallies and severe loss on downside crashes

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: The mirror opposite is the Short Straddle: Writing both a call and put at strike K to harvest maximum upfront cash credit.

hi.display: Iska exact mirror opposite hai: The Short Straddle yaani Top Straddle. Jahan trader ek Call aur ek Put dono ko same strike K par sell karke upfront maximum cash credit collect karta hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Short Straddle: High-Stakes Volatility Selling

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: This strategy is deployed when a trader possesses conviction that the market will remain completely dead and stagnant at strike K.

hi.display: Ye strategy tab deploy ki jaati hai jab trader ko complete conviction ho ki stock bilkul stagnant rahega aur market bilkul dead rahegi.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Short Straddle: High-Stakes Volatility Selling

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Caution: This is one of derivatives trading's most perilous strategies! An explosive move in either direction unleashes infinite losses.

hi.display: Lekin dhyan rahe: ye derivatives trading ki sabse dangerous strategies mein se ek hai! Agar stock kisi bhi taraf explode kar jaye, toh infinite losses ho sakte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Short Straddle: High-Stakes Volatility Selling

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: On Wall Street, numerous hedge funds have been liquidated overnight due to unhedged negative gamma on short straddles.

hi.display: Wall Street par kai hedge funds short straddles ke unhedged negative gamma risk ki wajah se raaton-raat liquidate ho chuke hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Short Straddle: High-Stakes Volatility Selling

scenes.title: Asymmetric Volatility Bets: Strips and Straps
scenes.purpose: A Strip combines 1 Call + 2 Puts at strike K; profits more aggressively from downward price moves
takeaways: A Strip combines 1 Call + 2 Puts at strike K; profits more aggressively from downward price moves
A Strap combines 2 Calls + 1 Put at strike K; profits more aggressively from upward rallies
Both strategies capture volatility while reflecting asymmetric directional market views

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: In practice, views are rarely symmetrical; traders expect huge volatility, but believe one direction is far more likely.

hi.display: Real-world desks par aksar traders ka view perfectly symmetrical nahi hota; unhe lagta hai ki move toh huge aayega, lekin kisi ek direction ki probability zyada hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Asymmetric Volatility Bets: Strips and Straps

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: For this situation, John Hull introduces two asymmetric structures: Strips and Straps.

hi.display: Is situation ke liye John Hull do asymmetric structures introduce karte hain: Strips aur Straps.

beats.onScreenIntent: Asymmetric Volatility Bets: Strips and Straps

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: A Strip is a bearish volatility trade: 1 Call plus 2 Puts are bought. A crash generates profits at double velocity.

hi.display: Strip ek bearish volatility trade hai: Isme ek Call ke sath do Puts buy kiye jaate hain. Agar stock crash ho jaye, toh double rate par profit banta hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Asymmetric Volatility Bets: Strips and Straps

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Conversely, a Strap is a bullish volatility trade: 2 Calls plus 1 Put are bought, delivering double payoff on upward surges.

hi.display: Iska opposite Strap ek bullish volatility trade hai: Isme do Calls ke sath ek Put buy kiya jata hai, jo upward explosion par double payoff deliver karta hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Asymmetric Volatility Bets: Strips and Straps

scenes.title: The Strangle: Widening the Corridor to Slash Premium Outlay
scenes.purpose: A Long Strangle buys an OTM put (strike K1) and an OTM call (strike K2) where K1 < K2
takeaways: A Long Strangle buys an OTM put (strike K1) and an OTM call (strike K2) where K1 < K2
In Hull's example: S0 = $54, Put K1=$50 ($1.50), Call K2=$60 ($2.00); Total Cost = $3.50 (vs $7 for straddle)
Breakevens are $46.50 ($50 - $3.50) and $63.50 ($60 + $3.50); cheaper entry but requires wider move

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: The major drawback of a straddle is the high cost of ATM options. To slash this outlay, the Strangle was invented.

hi.display: Straddle ka sabse bada drawback ye hota hai ki At-the-Money options buy karna behad expensive hota hai. Is capital cost ko slash karne ke liye invent hua: The Strangle.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Strangle: Widening the Corridor to Slash Premium Outlay

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: In a strangle, we buy an OTM put at K1 and an OTM call at K2. Because both legs are OTM, upfront premium cost is slashed.

hi.display: Strangle mein trader lower strike K one ka Put buy karta hai aur higher strike K two ka Call buy karta hai. Kyunki dono options Out-of-the-Money hote hain, upfront cost dramatically kam ho jaati hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Strangle: Widening the Corridor to Slash Premium Outlay

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: However, breakevens widen: Profitability requires the stock to plunge far below K1 or rocket far above K2.

hi.display: Lekin tradeoff ye hai ki breakevens wider ho jaate hain: Profit mein aane ke liye stock ko ya toh lower strike K one se bohot neeche girna hoga ya K two se bohot upar break out karna hoga.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Strangle: Widening the Corridor to Slash Premium Outlay

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: If the stock settles between K1 and K2 at expiration, the entire net debit is lost.

hi.display: Agar stock expiration par strikes K one aur K two ke beech flat rehta hai, toh poora premium debit loss ban jata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Strangle: Widening the Corridor to Slash Premium Outlay

scenes.title: Business Snapshot 12.2: Earnings Announcements & The IV Crush Trap
scenes.purpose: Implied volatility surges into earnings as market makers price binary earnings event risk
takeaways: Implied volatility surges into earnings as market makers price binary earnings event risk
Immediately after earnings release, uncertainty vanishes and implied volatility collapses ('IV Crush')
Even if the stock moves significantly, the collapse in Vega can cause long straddles to lose money

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: In Business Snapshot 12.2, John Hull exposes a catastrophic retail mistake: Buying straddles right before quarterly earnings.

hi.display: John Hull Business Snapshot twelve point two mein retail options buyers ki ek catastrophic mistake expose karte hain: Quarterly Earnings announcements se theek pehle Straddle buy karna.

beats.onScreenIntent: Business Snapshot 12.2: Earnings Announcements & The IV Crush Trap

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Retailers expect earnings jumps to generate profits, forgetting that pre-earnings IV is at extreme peaks, inflating option premiums.

hi.display: Retail traders sochte hain ki earnings ke baad stock jump karega aur straddle huge profit dega. Lekin wo bhool jaate hain ki earnings se pehle Implied Volatility extreme peaks par hoti hai, jisse premiums artificially inflated hote hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Business Snapshot 12.2: Earnings Announcements & The IV Crush Trap

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: The moment numbers are released, uncertainty resolves and IV collapses: Known on trading desks as 'IV Crush'.

hi.display: Jaise hi quarterly numbers public hote hain, uncertainty khatam ho jati hai aur Implied Volatility collapse ho jati hai: jise trading floor par I-V Crush kehte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Business Snapshot 12.2: Earnings Announcements & The IV Crush Trap

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Collapsing IV slashes call and put values by 40% to 60% instantly, handing the trader steep losses despite stock movement!

hi.display: IV crash hone se Call aur Put dono ki prices instantly 40 se 60 percent gir jaati hain, aur stock move karne ke bawajood trader ko massive loss face karna padta hai!

beats.onScreenIntent: Business Snapshot 12.2: Earnings Announcements & The IV Crush Trap

scenes.title: Active Recall Scenario: Straddle Breakeven & Payoff Calculation
scenes.purpose: Given strike K = $100, Call premium c = $6.00, Put premium p = $4.00: Total Cost = $10.00
takeaways: Given strike K = $100, Call premium c = $6.00, Put premium p = $4.00: Total Cost = $10.00
Upper Breakeven = $100 + $10 = $110.00; Lower Breakeven = $100 - $10 = $90.00
If stock price moves to $125 at expiration: Net Profit = ($125 - $100) - $10.00 = $15.00 per share

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Let us test your active recall understanding on a concrete quantitative straddle problem from John Hull.

hi.display: Aaiye ab aapki active recall understanding ko John Hull ke ek concrete quantitative straddle problem par test karte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Active Recall Scenario: Straddle Breakeven & Payoff Calculation

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Stock is $50. Trader buys $50 Call for $4.00 and $50 Put for $3.00. Calculate total outlay, upper/lower breakevens, and maximum loss.

hi.display: Stock fifty dollars par trade ho raha hai. Trader fifty dollar strike ka Call four dollars mein buy karta hai, aur fifty dollar strike ka Put three dollars mein buy karta hai. Total initial investment, upper breakeven, lower breakeven, aur maximum loss calculate kijiye.

beats.onScreenIntent: Active Recall Scenario: Straddle Breakeven & Payoff Calculation

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: The correct answer is Option A. Total premium outlay is $4.00 + $3.00 = $7.00 per share.

hi.display: Sahi answer Option A hai. Total premium cost four dollars plus three dollars yani seven dollars per share hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Active Recall Scenario: Straddle Breakeven & Payoff Calculation

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Upper breakeven is $50 + $7 = $57, lower breakeven is $50 - $7 = $43, and maximum loss is capped at $7.00 per share!

hi.display: Upper breakeven fifty plus seven यानी fifty-seven dollars hai, lower breakeven fifty minus seven यानी forty-three dollars hai, aur maximum loss precisely seven dollars per share hai!

beats.onScreenIntent: Active Recall Scenario: Straddle Breakeven & Payoff Calculation

data.question: An investor purchases a 3-month Long Straddle with strike K = $100. The call costs $6.00 and the put costs $4.00. What are the Breakeven stock prices, and what is the net profit per share if the stock closes at $125 at expiration?
options: The equilibrium condition holds via continuous risk-neutral replication.
Expected asset drift determines contingent claim value directly.
Arbitrage bounds can be systematically violated in liquid markets.
Discrete binomial tree steps eliminate all underlying price variance.
data.explanation: Total Cost = $6.00 + $4.00 = $10.00. Upper Breakeven = $100 + $10 = $110.00; Lower Breakeven = $100 - $10 = $90.00. At S_T = $125, the call pays $125 - $100 = $25, and the put expires worthless ($0). Net Profit = $25 - $10 Total Cost = $15.00 per share ($1,500 per contract).

scenes.title: Master Strategy Matrix: Straddle vs Strangle vs Calendar
scenes.purpose: Choose Straddles when anticipating massive, explosive volatility and tight breakeven timing
takeaways: Choose Straddles when anticipating massive, explosive volatility and tight breakeven timing
Choose Strangles when volatility is anticipated but capital outlay must be minimized
Choose Calendar Spreads when expecting range-bound consolidation and rising deferred volatility

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: On institutional desks, non-directional strategies are chosen across three dimensions: Capital Cost, Greeks, and Regime.

hi.display: Institutional desks par non-directional strategies select karte waqt traders teen dimensions ko systematically evaluate karte hain: Capital Cost, Greek Sensitivity, aur Market Regime.

beats.onScreenIntent: Master Strategy Matrix: Straddle vs Strangle vs Calendar

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Straddles are expensive with tighter breakevens; strangles are cheap but demand violent breakouts. Both are long Vega.

hi.display: Straddles expensive hote hain lekin tight breakevens provide karte hain. Strangles cheap hote hain lekin violent breakout demand karte hain. Dono positive Vega carry karte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Master Strategy Matrix: Straddle vs Strangle vs Calendar

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Conversely, Calendar Spreads carry positive Theta: The passage of time becomes the trader's greatest asset.

hi.display: Iske opposite Calendar Spreads positive Theta carry karte hain: Jahan samay ka beetna trader ka sabse bada friend ban jata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Master Strategy Matrix: Straddle vs Strangle vs Calendar

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Understanding market dynamics allows deploying the optimal volatility structure for each unique regime.

hi.display: Market ki structural dynamics ko samajh kar aap right conditions mein right volatility strategy deploy kar sakte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Master Strategy Matrix: Straddle vs Strangle vs Calendar

scenes.purpose: Calendar spreads monetize non-linear Theta decay by selling front-month and buying back-month
takeaways: Calendar spreads monetize non-linear Theta decay by selling front-month and buying back-month
Straddles and strangles trade pure volatility magnitude, independent of market direction
Beware the post-earnings IV crush; Chapter 13 advances into Binomial Option Trees

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Let us consolidate the four core non-directional trading principles of Chapter 12 Part 2.

hi.display: Aaiye Chapter Twelve Part Two ke chaar core non-directional trading principles ko consolidate karte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Summary Thread: Four Core Volatility & Time Trading Laws

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Pillar 1: Time Decay Harvesting. Calendar Spreads capture accelerating front-month Theta decay for steady cash flows.

hi.display: Pillar One: Time Decay Harvesting. Calendar Spreads short-dated options ke accelerating Theta decay ko capture karke steady positive cash flows deliver karte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Summary Thread: Four Core Volatility & Time Trading Laws

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Pillar 2: Straddle Convexity. Long Straddles monetize explosive volatility, unlocking unlimited gains on violent breakouts.

hi.display: Pillar Two: Straddle Convexity. Long Straddles pure non-directional volatility expand karte hain, jahan explosive price movement unlimited upside unlock karta hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Summary Thread: Four Core Volatility & Time Trading Laws

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Pillar 3: Cost-Efficient Strangles. Out-of-the-money strangles slash capital outlay and establish wide breakout brackets.

hi.display: Pillar Three: Cost-Efficient Strangles. Out-of-the-money strangles upfront capital expenditure reduce karte hain aur wide price brackets establish karte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Summary Thread: Four Core Volatility & Time Trading Laws

beats.speaker: mentor
